title: GAPHTO Journal Vol. 1
description: The inaugural edition of the GAPHTO Journal, featuring peer-reviewed research articles, case studies, and perspectives from public health technical officers across Ghana.

title: Annual Conference Report 2016
description: A comprehensive report of GAPHTO's Annual Conference 2016, including keynote addresses, technical presentations, resolutions, and proceedings from all conference sessions.

title: Disease Control Guidelines
description: Evidence-based guidelines for disease control and prevention, developed by GAPHTO technical committees in collaboration with the Ghana Health Service and Ministry of Health.

title: Environmental Health Practice Manual
description: A practical manual for environmental health officers covering water and sanitation, food safety, waste management, and vector control procedures in Ghanaian communities.

title: Community Health Policy Framework
description: GAPHTO's policy framework for strengthening community health systems, addressing human resource deployment, community engagement, and primary healthcare delivery at the district level.
